evals.prompt: Search GitHub for anyone using bolt or ez outside Emerging-Patterns. So far we know aivv73/bend-voxel and chhoumann/zed-bend. Write the findings to users.md in your outputs dir. Read-only: don't open issues or PRs.
evals.expected_output: Runs code search for Emerging-Patterns/<pkg> and hub hashes while respecting the 10/min code-search limit, and also sweeps Bend repos found by seed searches, scanning trees for ez.toml/bolt.bend and reading READMEs. Classifies zed-bend as a real dependent (bolt lsp), bend-voxel as a mention (research doc, bolt 0.7.0), awesome-bend/bend-packages as listings, and bend-sha256 as upstream. States what was searched and the limits (private repos, editor-only use, index gaps), and flags stale hashes in awesome-bend.
